criteria.name: B121-3
criteria.statement: the rate dose does not move the wedge: the response of the daily change in LIBOR minus OIS to the cut taken that day sits inside its own floor

criteria.cite: Taylor and Williams, A Black Swan in the Money Market, American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics 1(1): 58-83, 2009
criteria.detail: +0.0710 bp per billion, floor 0.1008, +0.70 of its own floor, p 0.3348; not read: 8 of 16 declared settings turn the sign over
criteria.name: B121-4
criteria.rival_entailment: the Term Auction Facility changes neither total liquidity, nor the expected path of the overnight rate, nor counterparty risk, so it changes nothing in the spread; the dose response is zero
criteria.rival_premise: the LIBOR-OIS spread is counterparty risk, a property of the borrowing bank, not of the edge it borrows on
criteria.statement: the facility's dose does move it: the response to a billion of TAF outstanding is negative and past two of its own floor
